findings.current: Or if Jin Taekyung had possessed a Dragonheart, brimming with power almost without limit like his own, perhaps it would be Morgoth—not Jin Taekyung—standing there now.
findings.defect: Reverses who Morgoth imagines would be standing.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says 진태경, not 자신, might be standing there.
findings.replacement: Or if Jin Taekyung had possessed a Dragonheart, brimming with power almost without limit like his own, perhaps Jin Taekyung would be the one standing there now instead of him.
findings.source: 혹은 진태경이 자신처럼 무한에 가까운 힘을 품은 드래곤 하트(Dragonheart)를 갖고 있었더라면, 지금 서 있는 것은 자신이 아닌 진태경이었을지도 모른다고.

findings.current: “You didn’t think I’d overlook something this obvious, did you?”
findings.defect: The negative question suggests Jin did not expect Morgoth to miss it; Morgoth is challenging Jin for thinking he would fail to anticipate it.
findings.rationale: 예상 못 할 줄 알았나 asks whether Jin thought Morgoth could not anticipate even this much.
findings.replacement: “Did you think I wouldn’t see even this coming?”
findings.source: 고작 이 정도도 예상 못 할 줄 알았나.

findings.current: Jin Taekyung surged forward, propelled by the explosive force of Flamefire Path, and brought his spear down with all his strength.
findings.defect: Changes Jin’s upward surge into forward movement.
findings.rationale: 솟구쳐 오른 describes rising before the downward spear strike.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung shot upward on the explosive force of Flamefire Path and brought his spear down with all his strength.
findings.source: 염화일로(炎火一路)의 폭발력을 바탕으로 솟구쳐 오른 진태경은 온 힘을 다해 창날을 내리그었다.

findings.defect: Loses the pointedly contemptuous address that marks Morgoth’s abandonment of polite speech.
findings.rationale: 네놈 is insulting rather than the courteous 자네 Morgoth used earlier; the preceding narration explicitly marks that register shift.
findings.replacement: “Because I’m… afraid of you, you bastard.”
findings.source:
상대가 아닌 오직 자신의 기품을 위해 사용해 왔던 최소한의 존대도, 실낱처럼 남아 있던 마지막 한 조각의 오만도 내려놓은 모르고스가 나직이 덧붙였다.

- 나는…… 네놈이 두려우니까.

findings.current: Using his foot, heavy with a thousand pounds of weight, as his pivot,
findings.defect: Omits the step and makes the foot itself heavy rather than describing a weighty step.
findings.rationale: 내디디며 is the action of stepping; the planted foot becomes the axis of the strike.
findings.replacement: He planted a step with the weight of a thousand pounds, using that foot as his pivot,
findings.source: 천근의 무게를 담은 발을 축으로 삼아 내디디며

findings.current: A storm that swept everything away, and an inferno capable of burning anything.
findings.defect: Drops the established rendering of 겁화.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary specifies “hellfire” for 겁화.
findings.replacement: A storm that swept everything away, and hellfire capable of burning anything.
findings.source: 모든 것을 휩쓰는 폭풍인 동시에, 무엇이든 불태울 수 있는 겁화를.

findings.current: A supreme power granted only to Dragons.
findings.defect: Narrows the stated recipients from dragonkin to Dragons.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary distinguishes 용족, “dragonkin,” from 드래곤, “Dragon.”
findings.replacement: A supreme power granted only to dragonkin.

findings.defect: Retains square brackets around a term inside a System panel.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rules prohibit square brackets around System UI terms.

summary: One reversal of who would be standing, plus errors in Morgoth’s challenge, combat mechanics, and terminology.
